correctness.rationale: Exact competing-hazard calculations yield identical root and nonroot local full-child factors; tree unique-path structure makes the pre-sampled vertex-originated local success events independent, establishing an all-size product. Pairing reciprocal denominator terms and the tree handshaking identity give the sharp path-only bound, including leaf and two-vertex boundaries. A separate direct 3-state rational CTMC checker passes 567 tree/profile cases and 2958 exact per-root comparisons. Enumeration is only corroborative.

value.rationale: Full dissemination before rumor stifling is a natural finite-network reliability objective distinct from mean reach and infinite survival. The theorem combines exact immunity to seed selection even under vertex-dependent rates, degree-multiset invariance under common ratios and sharp unique path optimality at every size. The all-order structural comparison is motivated and is not a small numerical increment; no empirical interpretation is asserted.
